name: Steal
overview: Scripture clearly forbids stealing, as stated in the Ten Commandments and reaffirmed in Romans 13:9, emphasizing that love for our neighbor undergirds this command. The thief’s intent is contrasted with Christ’s purpose of giving abundant life, highlighting the destructive nature of theft (John 10:10). Believers are called to a transformed life that rejects worldly patterns, turning instead to honest labor so they can bless others in need (Romans 12:2; Ephesians 4:28). Righteousness, not ill-gotten gain, leads to true deliverance and life (Proverbs 10:2).
